recommendation: Provide comprehensive case management for substance use disorders
implementation_steps: Conduct thorough substance use disorder assessments
Provide case management to coordinate treatment and recovery services
Connect patients to social and behavioral health resources
Assist with insurance navigation and benefits applications
Address psychosocial needs affecting treatment engagement and recovery
evidence_summary: Social worker-led case management interventions have demonstrated improvements in treatment engagement, retention, and outcomes for patients with substance use disorders, particularly when addressing social determinants of health.
